content: Zustand stores work identically inside and outside React (plain JS store with getState/setState/subscribe), which makes it the natural bridge between an imperative Three.js raycast callback (calls store.getState().setSelection(id) directly, no hooks) and React components (use the useStore hook to subscribe and re-render on change). This avoids prop drilling, avoids re-running the Three.js setup effect when data/selection changes, and avoids a full event-emitter's manual subscription bookkeeping. Recommended over plain lifted React state (would force selection state into a component that must also own the Three.js mount effect) and over a raw EventEmitter (loses React's built-in subscription/render optimization).
